context: Write docs/adr/0005-hosted-credential-provider.md as an additive ADR that depends on and does not amend ADR 0004, and record six decisions. G1 Acceptance criterion: state one testable sentence, 'on a machine provisioned once, a new shell or agent session in any repo runs the repository wrapper against the hosted tracker with zero interactive steps, and reauthentication is required no more often than the ADR 0004 rotation maximum'. G2 Mechanism: choose between a TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND retrieval hook, a first-party OS-keychain reader, or both; record the rejected options and why. G3 Precedence: DatabaseConfig.auth_token, then TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN/TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN per requested capability, then the provider, then E_AUTH_MISSING; environment variables stay the CI and override interface and the provider becomes the interactive default. G4 Provider protocol: how the requested capability reaches the provider, and the absent-versus-error contract (exit 0 with empty stdout means the credential is absent and capability fallback may continue; a non-zero exit means an error and stops resolution). G5 Provisioning: decide whether a first-party provisioning subcommand ships or the runbook documents the external one-liner, and record that either outcome must still leave a documented procedure named by the exit-4 remediation text. G6 Boundary: record that retrieval is not storage, that todo-db still never mints, caches, or persists a bearer token, and that ADR 0004 stands unamended. Cross-link the runbook and README; change no runtime source in this item.
description: v0.4.2 removed wrapper auto-minting but shipped no component to replace it, so ADR 0004's 'password managers, OS keychains, CI secret stores and process supervisors own storage and injection' describes parts that do not exist. Every interactive caller (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Pi, plain shells) now fails with E_AUTH_MISSING unless a human exported a token into that process first. This item records ADR 0005: a retrieval-only credential provider boundary that keeps every ADR 0004 decision intact (no runtime minting, no secret storage in todo-db, no Turso control-plane authority in agent environments) while restoring one-time provisioning plus zero-interaction reuse. It is documentation only, and it is explicitly not the delivery surface: hosted-credential-provider and hosted-auth-acceptance-gate carry the user-visible outcome.

anti_patterns.dont: Amend, weaken, or reopen ADR 0004 to restore automatic minting or in-process secret storage
anti_patterns.instead: add ADR 0005 as an additive retrieval-only boundary that depends on 0004
anti_patterns.why: 0004's security decisions were correct; reopening them re-litigates sound work and reintroduces per-command token churn

anti_patterns.dont: Grant every agent ambient read-write tracker authority for convenience
anti_patterns.instead: resolve a capability-matched credential and pass it only to the todo-db child process
anti_patterns.why: a compromised prompt, extension, or repository script would otherwise be able to mutate the tracker

anti_patterns.dont: Record decisions without a single testable acceptance criterion
anti_patterns.instead: state one measurable sentence that the acceptance harness can assert
anti_patterns.why: no gate in the v0.4.2 cycle carried a user-facing success condition, so every gate passed while the product failed

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a merged ADR and runbook as the completed outcome
anti_patterns.instead: keep the dependent provider and acceptance items open as the user-visible deliverable
anti_patterns.why: the previous cycle shipped policy without the component and moved the authentication burden onto the user

preserves.behavior: ADR 0004's decisions remain in force: no runtime token minting, no bearer tokens written to disk, config, logs, or tracker evidence, and no Turso control-plane authority in normal command paths.
Environment variables remain a supported explicit override and the portable CI interface; the provider never overrides a credential that was explicitly supplied.
TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 remains a non-secret compatibility handshake and gains no authentication meaning from this ADR.
The dependent items hosted-credential-provider and hosted-auth-acceptance-gate remain the delivery surface; completing this ADR does not complete the plan.
